description: Ministry Environment - Waranagalawatta, Environmental Protection Area.
categorisation: This gazette content establishes a new Environmental Protection Area under the National Environmental Act, No. 47 of 1980. It contains a legal order with regulatory provisions, including the declaration of protected land, cessation of conflicting planning schemes, and assignment of powers to the Central Environmental Authority. This fits Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory) as it involves regulatory frameworks, statutory instruments, and legal amendments to environmental protection laws.
